findings.text: the merge appends a copy of the grant after the grant's own row was already appended at ticker.py:2352, so a grant that replaces another is drawn twice at the same clock time; the gate at tests/test_a_lift_row_reads_as_a_lift.py:131 counts only rows containing "replaces" and passes whatever the plain grant row does.

the replaced lift id is inferred from stream order (the last in-force row for the (group, session) key) rather than read from the producer's own record, so a replay whose anchor starts after the grant draws the end as landed again — the original defect — and the manifest records the structural field as outside this node's scope.

_lift_line duplicates the trailing-cell, spend, stats and paint scaffolding of _reset_line at ticker.py:3117 instead of extending that owner, so the next change to the trailing-cell rules must be made in two places.
